disputed_instances.excerpt: I propose a confidential regulator-and-assessor reporting pathway for per-model test results, with no public release of company-specific failure rates. An 8% limit preserves a meaningful safety threshold while allowing corrective action and regulator oversight before certification consequences.

I’ve revised S2 to keep exact per-model rates with regulators and the independent assessor, while giving customers safety-relevant summaries and corrective-action information. I propose an 8% limit with mandatory investigation, retesting, and regulator-supervised safeguards above that threshold. This preserves oversight without publicly disclosing company-specific failure rates.

The proposed 8% threshold is paired with mandatory investigation, retesting, and regulator-supervised safeguards above the limit; it does not prevent proportionate protective action.
